part1.intro: The examiner asks you about yourself, your home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Drinks
questions: What do you like to drink with your dinner? [Why?]
Do you drink a lot of water every day? [Why/Why not?]
Do you prefer drinking tea or coffee? [Why?]
If people visit you in your home, what do you usually offer them to drink? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe a monument (e.g., a statue or sculpture) that you like.
part2.closing: and explain why you like this monument.

topics.title: Public monuments
questions: What kinds of monuments do tourists in your country enjoy visiting?
Why do you think there are often statues of famous people in public places?
Do you agree that old monuments and buildings should always be preserved?

topics.title: Architecture
questions: Why is architecture such a popular university subject?
In what ways has the design of homes changed in recent years?
To what extent does the design of buildings affect people's moods?
